# wso2is_admin_advisory_banner (Resource)

Manages the advisory banner on the Console sign-in page. The resource only changes the settings that you set. Other settings keep their current values. When you destroy this resource, the settings keep their current values, and Terraform stops managing them. Each tenant (or organization) has one set of these settings. To import them, use the ID `admin_advisory_banner`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_admin_advisory_banner" "this" {
  enabled = true
  content = "Authorized use only. Activity is logged."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `content` (String) Banner text.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Show the banner.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `admin_advisory_banner`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_admin_advisory_banner.this admin_advisory_banner
```
